items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Vic Dickenson gave me a mouthpiece.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Cliff brought the horn home, Vic Dickenson gave me a mouthpiece. And I used that mouthpiece to practice with.
And Cliff had a friend who was a trumpet player. And I used to go over to his house and he'd teach me what to do -- you know, how to practice, and all that.
